meta.title: Careers · Mateos
meta.description: Founding engineer and AI Enabler roles at Mateos. Build the machine that runs owner-led companies.

head.lead: Six people on the machine today. We hire ahead of demand, not behind it, and every hire sits in client rooms within the first month.

open.title: Two roles open now.
open.lead: Both roles are hands-on. You will be on site with the people who do the work, and you will ship inside the client's own environment.

roles.title: Founding engineer
body: Lead R&D with the CTO. Design and build the connectors, the rules engine, the exception desk and the monitoring that carry a process end to end inside a client's ERP, CRM and mailboxes.
Senior. You have shipped systems that other people depend on, and you can explain them to a plant manager.
roles.apply: Apply: write to hello@mateos.ai with the subject line Founding engineer.

roles.title: AI Enabler
body: Not a developer role. You run the X-ray: a day on site, the map in stations, the time per station, the ranked list. Then you stay with the client through the pilot and own the number.
You have run operations or a department in a mid-size company, and you are comfortable with data, documents and systems.
roles.apply: Apply: write to hello@mateos.ai with the subject line AI Enabler.

open.note: No recruiters. Written replies within one working week.

cta.title: It's your company. Your move.
cta.lead: Start with an X-ray. One day on site with the people who do the work, or one small agent. Every process ranked by payback. From $990.
